trainer_contract.architecture: Two stride-2 convolutions, a hidden projection, diagonal-Gaussian encoder, transposed-convolution decoder.
trainer_contract.image_support: uint8 2D images with 1 or 3 channels; height and width divisible by 4, at most 64.
trainer_contract.likelihood: Fixed standard deviation 0.1 Gaussian on pixels scaled by 255; beta=1 ELBO.
trainer_contract.generation: Standard-normal latent, Gaussian decoder draws clipped to [0,1]; decoder means also saved separately.
trainer_contract.conditioning: One-hot class labels concatenated in encoder and decoder; balanced generation across observed classes.

common_contract.optimizer: VAE default: Adam (betas 0.9, 0.999); gradient norm clipped to 10; float32. GAN uses its explicit per-model optimizer contract.
common_contract.validation: VAE only: one fixed-seed Monte Carlo ELBO estimate per validation observation; lowest complete validation loss selects checkpoint.
common_contract.training: Plan supplies latent_dim, hidden_dim, batch_size, epochs, learning_rate, patience, max_minutes, selected_features, generate_samples.
common_contract.resource_limits: Cooperative batch-boundary checks plus parent wall-time/RSS supervision. MPS driver allocation is checked by the worker. These are monitored limits, not OS reservation guarantees.

limitations: Training diagnostics are not evidence of synthetic-data quality or downstream utility.
Seeds are recorded; numerical identity across devices/library versions is not guaranteed.
